status: PREDECLARED before any run, 2026-10-17, author w2:pC (executant), protocol w2:p6 (docs/END_TO_END_E2E3_LOT.txt sections 0-7, amendement 1). Diagnostic of false positives of the E2E-1 checkpoints. Nothing launched before the GO of w2:p6 after the 30 min of w2:pK. No claim of OCR performance; the E2E-1 gate stays FAIL.

pages_regeneration.source: mille-feuilles at commit 23875ab05425ce2aa07742bf314d02436c2f5642 (clone of the gitbundle embedded in bundle v5)
pages_regeneration.source_check: the 51 tracked mille-feuilles files of the clone must have the sha256 listed in the bundle manifest (mille_feuilles_sha256)

model.alphabet: built from the train pages (build_alphabet), as at the E2E-1 run

replay_control.rule: mismatch -> status MISMATCH and no reading

classes_of_unmatched_predictions.matching: babaorum.line_geometry.v1 (evaluate_line_geometry, tolerance 0.5 x GT height), one-to-one
classes_of_unmatched_predictions.distance: DIRECTIONAL distance prediction -> GT: mean over the prediction's sampled points (4 px) of the distance to the GT polyline, divided by the GT height h (section 8(f) of the lot). The matching for the evaluation stays line_geometry.v1.
classes_of_unmatched_predictions.h: band height of the nearest GT line, i.e. the line with the smallest normalised distance (tie: smallest GT id)
classes_of_unmatched_predictions.order: D, then F, then H, then R; sum of counts = number of unmatched predictions (checked)
classes_of_unmatched_predictions.D_duplicate: a near GT line that is matched to ANOTHER prediction
classes_of_unmatched_predictions.F_fragment: a near GT line whose coverage by the prediction (GT samples within 0.5 h of the prediction) is < 0.5
classes_of_unmatched_predictions.H_hallucination: normalised distance to the nearest GT line > 1
classes_of_unmatched_predictions.R_rest: everything else, reported and never reread as another class
classes_of_unmatched_predictions.reference_line: the GT line with minimal normalised directional distance; ties go to the smallest GT id; only this line is used for D, F, H and h

readings.R1: dominant class (>= 50 % of the B3 false positives) decides the next lot: D -> post-processing; F -> extraction first; H -> cut or weight the CTC gradient into enc_det; none >= 50 % -> not explained here
readings.R2_H1: H1 supported if ratio(B3) > 1.5 AND ratio(S2) <= 1.2; contradicted if ratio(B3) <= 1.2 x ratio(S2); intermediate case reported as is; H1 stays a correlation between arms
readings.R3: no threshold changed after reading; the E2E-1 gate stays FAIL

R4_cosine.conflict_supported: IC95 of cos entirely < 0 AND median of rho >= 0.1
R4_cosine.negligible: median of ratio = norm_ctc / norm_det < 0.1 -> 'CTC gradient negligible' (checked first)
R4_cosine.otherwise: no conflict supported; IC containing 0 -> no measurable conflict; IC > 0 -> gradients aligned
R4_cosine.S2_control: rho must be 0 for S2; max norm_ctc on enc_det must be exactly 0
R4_cosine.scope: the cosine measures the FINAL state, not the training dynamics

cosine_measurement.sigma_step: sigma_for_step(1999, 2000, h) with h = scale.target_median_height_px (32 px), as in run_v2
cosine_measurement.vector: flattened parameters of enc_det, cosine between grad(L_det) and grad(L_ctc)
cosine_measurement.control_S2: grad(L_ctc) on enc_det must be exactly 0 for S2; otherwise MISMATCH
cosine_measurement.backward: two separate backward passes with zero_grad between them: L_det then L_ctc; flattened enc_det gradients
cosine_measurement.incomplete: if 200 attempts do not give 20 valid batches: status COSINE_INCOMPLETE with the number of skipped batches

budget.estimate: generation about 20 min; 30 full-page evaluations about 10-20 min; cosine about 5 min
budget.cap_scope: inference only: the 60-minute cap starts after the page-cache step and covers the replay, the classes and the cosine steps; generation is not part of it

reporting: reports/e2e3_fp_classes.json only for the final report; intermediate files in /private/tmp/e2e3
run_gate: NOT launched: waits for the explicit GO of w2:p6 after the 30 min of w2:pK

page_cache.accept: exactly 60 JSON pages and 60 PNG images; the sha256 of each file is recorded in the report
page_cache.refuse: any other content: status FAILED; run 2 never generates pages
page_cache.live_process_guard: refuse to start while a process e2e3_fp_classes or mille_feuilles is alive
